# SIDTD Source & Provenance

- **Publisher:** Computer Vision Center (CVC), Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona
- **Research Committee:** IAPR TC-11 (Reading Systems)
- **Primary Download URL:** `http://datasets.cvc.uab.es/SIDTD/templates.zip`
- **Official Splits URL:** `http://datasets.cvc.uab.es/SIDTD/split_normal.zip`
- **Acquired Archives:** `templates.zip` (~1.2 GB), `split_normal.zip` (21 KB), `hold_out_split_templates.zip` (16 KB), `kfold_split_templates.zip` (149 KB), `few_shot_split_templates.zip` (9 KB)
